components.description: Handles POST /animals and the three required lookups: one animal, all animals arriving on a date, and all animals from an origin. Without a filter it returns every registered animal; the two filters cannot be combined. Validates the request body before it reaches the service.
components.name: Animal REST API

components.description: Turns domain exceptions into HTTP status codes: 404 when the animal is unknown, 409 when the registration number is already in use, and 400 when the request body fails validation or combines both filters.
components.name: REST Exception Handler

components.description: Registration rules. Rejects a registration number that is already in use, and defaults the arrival time when the caller leaves it out. Writes the animal and the outbox event in one transaction. Knows nothing about HTTP.
components.name: Animal Registration Service

relationships.description: Writes the event in the same transaction via

components.description: Derived queries for lookup by registration number, by arrival date as a half-open interval in the configured slaughterhouse time zone, and by origin.
components.name: Animal Repository

components.description: The registration service's own view of an animal: registration number, arrival time, weight and origin. Created on registration; the REST API currently exposes no update operation.
components.name: Animal Entity

components.description: Pending events waiting to be forwarded, each with an event id, a type, a JSON payload and a status of PENDING or FAILED. Written in the same transaction as the animal, so a registration can never be stored without its event.
components.name: Outbox

components.description: Every five seconds by default, sends up to 100 pending events ordered by occurredAt. Stops on temporary failure; rejects become FAILED. Timestamp ties have no explicit ordering; no global station order.
components.name: Outbox Publisher

components.description: Posts the event payload to the backend. Translates 5xx and connection failures into 'try again later', and 4xx into 'this event will never be valid'.
components.name: Traceability Client

relationships.description: Delivers queued animal events using synchronous HTTP
Delivers queued animal events using synchronous HTTP

components.description: Handles POST /animal-parts, POST /trays and PUT /trays/{trayId}/animal-parts/{partId}, plus lookups of a single part or tray and of all of them. The placement is a PUT because the station resends after a failure and the same placement must not count twice.
components.name: Part and Tray REST API

components.description: Turns domain exceptions into HTTP status codes: 404 for an unknown part or tray, 409 for a duplicate id and for every broken tray rule, and 400 for an invalid request body.
components.name: REST Exception Handler

components.description: Registers parts, creates trays and places parts in trays. Writes the part or tray and the outbox event in one transaction. Delegates the tray rules to the entity rather than checking them itself.
components.name: Cutting Service

relationships.description: Reads and writes parts and trays via

components.description: AnimalPartRepository and TrayRepository, including a derived query for trays by part type.

relationships.description: Reads and writes parts and trays

components.description: The tray owns its own rules: it accepts only parts of its own type, it refuses a part that would take it past its maximum weight, placing the same part twice changes nothing, and a part already in another tray cannot be moved. The service uses addPart to enforce these rules.
components.name: Part and Tray Entities

components.description: Pending events for registered parts, created trays and placements, written in the same transaction as the data they describe.
components.name: Outbox

components.description: Every five seconds by default, sends up to 100 pending events ordered by occurredAt. Stops on temporary failure; rejects become FAILED. No global order across stations.
components.name: Outbox Publisher

components.description: Posts parts and trays to the backend, choosing the endpoint from the event type.

components.description: Handles POST /products and lookups of a single product and of all products. Rejects a product that was packed from no trays at all.
components.name: Product REST API

components.description: Turns domain exceptions into HTTP status codes: 404 for an unknown product, 409 for a duplicate product id, and 400 for an invalid request body.
components.name: REST Exception Handler

components.description: Packing rules. Rejects a product id that is already in use, and defaults the packing time when the caller leaves it out. Writes the product and the outbox event in one transaction.
components.name: Packing Service

relationships.description: Writes the event in the same transaction via

components.description: Reads and writes packed products.
components.name: Product Repository

components.description: A packed product with the tray ids it was packed from, stored as plain values. The station deliberately holds no reference to Station 2's tray objects, so the two can run and fail independently.
components.name: Product Entity

components.description: Pending events for packed products, written in the same transaction as the product.
components.name: Outbox

components.description: Every five seconds by default, sends up to 100 pending events ordered by occurredAt. Stops on temporary failure; rejects become FAILED. No global order across stations.
components.name: Outbox Publisher

components.description: Posts packed products to the backend.

containers.description: Owns the registered animals and Station 1's outbox. The station has its own store, so a registration can be accepted without any other part of the system being available.
containers.name: Registration Database

containers.description: Owns the parts and trays and Station 2's outbox. Lets the station keep cutting while the network or the backend is unavailable.

containers.description: Owns the packed products and Station 3's outbox. Lets the station keep packing while the network or the backend is unavailable.

components.description: Receives animals, parts, trays and products from the stations on POST /animals, /animal-parts, /trays and /products. Because the stations assign the ids, the same message twice gives the same result.
components.name: Ingestion REST API

components.description: Maps validation errors to 400. A NoSuchElementException maps to 503, but current ingestion creates placeholders for unknown animals and trays.
components.name: Backend Exception Handler

components.description: Stores what it is told, as an upsert. Creates placeholder animals and trays when references arrive before their details. Later messages fill them in. Tray weight is copied from tray messages; part placement currently does not refresh it.
components.name: Ingestion Service

components.description: Starts the gRPC server on the configured port and registers both the service and reflection, so Postman and BloomRPC can discover the contract.
components.name: gRPC Server Runner

relationships.description: Registers as a gRPC service and starts

components.description: Implements the server stub generated from traceability.proto: two list lookups and two full traces. Validates input and maps domain errors to status codes: NOT_FOUND, INVALID_ARGUMENT and INTERNAL.
components.name: gRPC API
components.technology: gRPC, Protocol Buffers, generated server stub

components.description: Traces products to animals and animals to products through trays, and returns the full chain for one animal or one part: every part, its tray and the products that tray reached. Stores a case counter and the latest case in memory. Independent of gRPC.
components.name: Traceability Service

components.description: AnimalRepository, AnimalPartRepository, TrayRepository and ProductRepository, all narrowed to save, findById and findAll by a shared base interface. Derived queries push the tracing down into the database.
components.name: Repositories

components.description: Animal, AnimalPart, Tray and Product, including the references that make tracing possible.
components.name: Domain Entities

components.description: Creates demo data on startup. Disabled by default via app.seed-demo-data.
components.name: Demo Data Seeder

containers.description: Receives what the stations report, stores the whole chain, and answers traceability lookups in both directions. REST on port 8080, gRPC on port 9090.
containers.name: Traceability Server
containers.technology: Java 21, Spring Boot, REST and gRPC
